All four panels respond to filters. Hover over a state for detail.

01 / Customer value pyramid

Annual spend proxy defines tiers. Recorded sales show their observed contribution.

02 / Promo exposure × repeat cadence

Value tiers are the comparison segments. Bubble area reflects recorded sales.

03 / Geographic opportunity map

US state tile map; position is schematic. Darker = higher smoothed full-price spend per customer.

Hover over a state to inspect sample size, spend and promo exposure.
Alaska and Hawaii are inset. Blank tiles have no customers under current filters.

04 / Category history mix

Entry-point / retention proxy. This is a cross-section, not an observed purchase journey.

Low: 0–10Mid: 11–25High: 26+
Read these metrics correctly. Repeat cadence proxy = previous purchases ≥26 and stated frequency ≥12/year. It is not a retention rate. Promo exposure records the current purchase only; it does not establish dependency. Annual spend proxy = current purchase amount × stated annual frequency, not forecast revenue or CLV. The high tier and repeat proxy both use cadence, so their association is partly constructed. State rankings are test hypotheses, not evidence of incremental acquisition returns.
